def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits (0 <= k <= 7), wrapping the high bits around."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    ex rotl8(0b10000001, 1) == 0b00000011
    ex rotl8(0b00000001, 0) == 0b00000001
    ex rotl8(0b00010010, 4) == 0b00100001
    xi = int(x)
    r = (xi << k) | (xi >> (8 - k))
    return wrap_as[uint8](r)
